rules.text: Length of the autonomous period (AUTO) in seconds. Manual value: 20.

citation.quote: During the first 20 seconds of the match, robots are autonomous.

rules.text: Total length of the teleoperated period (TELEOP) in seconds, including the transition shift, all alliance shifts and the end game. Manual value: 140.

citation.quote: During the remaining 2 minutes and 20 seconds, drivers control their robots.

rules.text: Length in seconds of ONE alternating ALLIANCE SHIFT (SHIFT 1, SHIFT 2, ...) during TELEOP. Manual value: 25.

citation.quote: SHIFT 125 Seconds2:10 – 1:45

rules.text: How many alternating ALLIANCE SHIFTS there are in TELEOP, not counting the transition shift or the end game. Manual value: 4.

citation.quote: There are four ALLIANCE SHIFTS named SHIFT 1, SHIFT 2, SHIFT 3, and SHIFT 4.

rules.text: Length in seconds of the END GAME at the end of TELEOP, when both HUBS are active. Manual value: 30.

citation.quote: END GAME30 Seconds0:30 – 0:00

rules.text: True if the ALLIANCE that scores more FUEL in AUTO has its own HUB inactive during the first alliance shift (SHIFT 1). Manual value: true.

citation.quote: The ALLIANCE that scores the most FUEL during AUTO will have their HUB set to inactive for SHIFT 1

rules.text: How many seconds before a HUB deactivates its lights or the field warn that it is about to become inactive. Manual value: 3.

citation.quote: HUB deactivation warning. Starts 3 seconds before and continues until deactivation or end of MATCH.

rules.text: MATCH points for one FUEL scored in an inactive HUB. Manual value: 0.

citation.quote: FUEL scored in an inactive HUB will not earn any points

rules.text: MATCH points for one ROBOT at TOWER LEVEL 2 at the end of TELEOP. Manual value: 20.

citation.quote: Each ROBOT at LEVEL 2-20

rules.text: MATCH points for one ROBOT at TOWER LEVEL 3 at the end of TELEOP. Manual value: 30.

citation.quote: Each ROBOT at LEVEL 330

rules.text: Maximum number of FUEL a ROBOT may be preloaded with before the MATCH. Manual value: 8.

citation.quote: 8 FUEL may be preloaded in each ROBOT

rules.text: Maximum number of seconds a ROBOT may PIN an opponent ROBOT before a violation. Manual value: 3.

citation.quote: A ROBOT may not PIN an opponent's ROBOT for more than 3 seconds.

rules.text: The rule number of the PINNING rule (for example G###). Manual value: G418.

citation.quote: G418 *There's a 3-count on PINS. A ROBOT may not PIN an opponent's ROBOT for more than 3 seconds.

rules.text: The violation for PINNING too long: MINOR FOUL or MAJOR FOUL (answer 'minor' or 'major'). Manual value: minor.

citation.quote: Violation: MINOR FOUL, and for every 3 seconds in which the situation is not corrected, a MAJOR FOUL is assessed.

rules.text: Distance in inches a ROBOT must back away to end a PIN. Manual value: 72.

citation.quote: A. the ROBOTS have separated by at least 72.0in (1.83m) from each other for more than 3 seconds

rules.text: Length of the FIELD in inches (the long dimension, ALLIANCE WALL to ALLIANCE WALL). Manual value: 651.2.

citation.quote: Each FIELD for REBUILT is an approximately 317.7in (~8.07m) by 651.2in (~16.54m) carpeted area

rules.text: Width of the FIELD in inches (the short dimension). Manual value: 317.7.

citation.quote: Each FIELD for REBUILT is an approximately 317.7in (~8.07m) by 651.2in (~16.54m) carpeted area

rules.text: Number of FUEL staged in each DEPOT at the start of a MATCH. Manual value: 24.

citation.quote: 24 FUEL are staged in each DEPOT

rules.text: Number of FUEL staged in each OUTPOST at the start of a MATCH. Manual value: 24.

citation.quote: 24 FUEL are staged in each OUTPOST CHUTE

rules.text: Total number of FUEL in a MATCH. Manual value: 504.

citation.quote: 504 FUEL are staged for each MATCH as follows

rules.text: Height in inches of the opening a ROBOT must fit under to drive through the TRENCH. Manual value: 22.25.

citation.quote: The space underneath each TRENCH arm is 50.34in (1.279m) wide, 22.25in (56.52cm) tall.
